outcome: Iron deficiency anemia (defined by serum ferritin concentration <30 micrograms/L and hemoglobin concentration <11 g/dl)
cohort: Children less than or equal to 6 months of age, of either sex, born at term gestation (37-42 weeks) with birth weight 2500 grams or more and an uneventful postnatal course.
finding: A significantly higher frequency of iron deficiency anemia was observed in exclusively breastfed children (35.6%) compared to non-exclusively breastfed children (14.9%) in the cohort.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to be significantly associated with iron deficiency anemia.
cross-section timing: At up to 6 months of age
